shorts.title: What you will learn: Lambdas with algorithms
shorts.hook: Give any algorithm your own rule.
shorts.script: Give any algorithm your own rule. Today we hand rules to algorithms. A lambda is a small function you write in the same place where you use it. A lambda has square brackets, a parameter list and a body. The square brackets are the capture list. They name outside variables that the lambda may read. Think of a sticky note with a small rule. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Lambdas with algorithms.

shorts.title: Lambdas with algorithms in one minute
shorts.hook: A lambda has square brackets, a parameter list and a body.
shorts.script: A lambda has square brackets, a parameter list and a body. The square brackets are the capture list. They name outside variables that the lambda may read. Think of a sticky note with a small rule. You hand the note to the algorithm, and it follows the rule. The empty square brackets mean the lambda captures nothing. It takes two ints. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: LAMBDAS WITH ALGORITHMS IN ONE MINUTE
shorts.caption: Lambdas with algorithms in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: A student has a name and marks.
shorts.script: A student has a name and marks. We sort the students. The lambda compares marks, so the highest marks come first. For each calls a lambda on every item. The lambda prints Asha ninety-one, then Mia eighty-five, then Ravi seventy-eight. The program prints the three students, from the highest marks to the lowest. A lambda is a small function with no name. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A variable that is not captured
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. The lambda reads limit, but the brackets are empty. The compiler says limit is not captured. Put limit in the square brackets. A lambda cannot see local variables unless you capture them. Write the name in the square brackets. Use an ampersand in front of the name to capture by reference. A lambda is a small function with no name. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: BUG OF THE DAY: A VARIABLE THAT IS NOT CAPTURED
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: A variable that is not captured.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Why did the lambda join the party? Nobody had to give it a name.
shorts.script: Why did the lambda join the party? Nobody had to give it a name. Use count if and a lambda to count the even numbers in a vector. Write your answer in the comments. A lambda is a small function with no name. The capture list names outside variables. Algorithms take lambdas as rules. Pass a struct by const reference to avoid a copy. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
